card.name: Words after rise or increase in
card.fires_on: The word or small linking word right after a noun of growth such as rise, increase, growth or incidence, where the thing that grew comes next. Usually "in" or "of", or a counted noun like cases or students.

modes.label: In/of after increase
modes.description: The linking word "in" or "of" directly after rise, increase or incidence.
modes.example: Researchers say an increase<< in>> childhood obesity may be one cause.

modes.label: Counted noun in a growth phrase
modes.description: The noun naming what is being counted, in a phrase about growing numbers.
modes.example: an "alarming" rise in<< cases>> of drug resistant tuberculosis.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that describe the amount or truth of the thing that increased, and away from words meaning large or abundant.
card.plain: It fires on the small word after "rise" or "increase" that is about to name what grew.
